scope: Replace the two four-step programs of the 2603/389 certificate by exchangeable conditional-iid block constructions: X2 first, then 2 or 3 iid copies of X4 given T4+c0; for copies=2 add the final X2 copy over T2+c0+all copies. The named copy programs' original marginal laws are preserved; only the valid auxiliary permutation symmetry is new.
